text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: GPU queue length > 10k and 95th p99 latency > 6s for inference-api-prod. Autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes. thread_ts=1777777777

emma: seeing huge request backlog + token throttles on hosted. dashboards show sustained enqueue growth since 04:12 UTC.

raj: oncall-ml paging in 2m. I can take first response.

marta: customer impact? any active customers getting 503s?

emma: yes — some large customers observe timeouts, retry storms causing more load. Alerting pipeline shows spikes in reroutes and throttles.

ops-bot: PagerDuty: incident P1 created (PD-6792) — oncall: @oncall-ml.

oncall-ml: i'm up. logging in. first pass: cluster-autoscaler failing with errors on nodegroup create: LaunchTemplate missing required IAM role and taint application failing. grabbing logs.

infra-sre: copy of autoscaler logs: 
```
I0327 04:15:03.123] scale-up: Pod can't be scheduled on existing nodes - insufficient nvidia.com/gpu (need 4, have 0)
E0327 04:15:03.124] Error creating nodegroup: AccessDenied: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform: ec2:RunInstances on resource: arn:aws:ec2:instance/*
E0327 04:15:03.124] Failed to label/taint node: Unable to apply taint: permission denied
```

emma: that AccessDenied started after the last launchtemplate rotation at 03:45. Could be a role ARN mismatch in the new template.

raj: confirming: launch template version v3 is set as default for gpu-ng-1? that was updated by infra pipeline last night.

marta: are there any fallback pools available (dedicated / warm nodes) we can redirect traffic to?

emma: we have a small dedicated pool in us-west-2 but it's maxed out at 75% and cannot accept more due to quota. Could re-route low-priority requests to a CPU-only fallback model to reduce GPU pressure.

oncall-ml: mitigation plan: 1) stop new low-priority jobs at router 2) scale down concurrency limits for heavy routes 3) try manual ASG scale-up with temporary role override 4) inform CS.

infra-sre: attempting manual nodegroup create using infra-admin creds to verify IAM block. running: 
```
aws eks create-nodegroup --cluster-name prod-cluster --nodegroup-name temp-gpu-test --scaling-config minSize=0,maxSize=10,desiredSize=2 --launch-template name=lt-gpu,version=3 --node-role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodNodeRoleTest
```

infra-sre: response: AccessDenied for RunInstances with arn referencing role/RedwoodNodeRoleTest even though that role exists. seems the launch template uses an instance profile that the nodegroup role doesn't have trust to assume.

raj: ok. two immediate options: A) revert launch template default to v2 (prev known-good) which has proper IAM; B) update node-role/trust policy in IAM and then allow nodegroup creation. Option A is faster.

emma: would reverting LT require a pipeline change? How quick?

infra-sre: we can flip default LT in AWS console quick, but need approval from infra oncall. doing it now in console and will not delete v3.

marta: while that's in flight, i'm going to add rate-limits at the API gateway to throttle bursty clients and set a routing rule to send non-urgent traffic to cpu-only model.

oncall-ml: please post exact commands you used so we can reproduce rollback in postmortem.

infra-sre: rolled back default launch template to v2 at 04:34 UTC. now triggering a manual scale up of gpu-ng-1 via ASG + desiredCapacity=3.

ops-bot: Deploy-bot: Scaling event requested by infra-sre on ASG gpu-ng-1 -> desired 3.

emma: seeing new instances starting (04:38). kubelet joining but taint application still shows intermittent failure on first init.

infra-sre: nodes joining now, kubelet ready, taints applied successfully on 3 nodes. cluster-autoscaler registered scale-up.

oncall-ml: queue drain visible: enqueue dropping and p99 latency decreasing. good signal.

marta: applied temporary routing: 25% of low-priority traffic -> cpu-fallback models. cpu fallback latency higher but keeps customers served.

cs-lead: drafting customer notice for impacted customers: short message acknowledging degraded inference latency and that we are scaling GPUs; ETA for full restoration ~30-45m. sharing draft.

cs-lead: "We are experiencing degraded latency for inference requests due to GPU capacity issues; we've initiated emergency scaling and mitigations (routing low-priority requests to CPU-fallbacks). We're monitoring and will update in 30 minutes."

emma: please include note that no data loss and requests are being retried where possible.

infra-sre: monitoring shows autoscaler now stable. however we need root cause: launch template v3 introduced an instance profile ARN mismatch—pipeline set wrong instance profile during template creation. Opening infra ticket INFRA-2387 to revert pipeline change and add CI check.

raj: action items we need to capture: 
- INFRA: fix LT creation pipeline to use correct instance profile and add linting/CI (owner: infra-sre, ticket INFRA-2387)
- PLAT: add autoscaler playbook step for quick LT revert and manual ASG path (owner: emma)
- API: implement automatic low-priority fallback routing when GPU queue > threshold (owner: marta)
- CS: customer notification sent and follow-up (owner: cs-lead)
- SRE: run capacity audit and request quota bump for dedicated pool (owner: raj)

oncall-ml: set incident severity to Sev2 now that routing and nodes recovered; moving to monitoring.

ops-bot: Incident status updated: P1 -> P2 at 04:55 UTC by oncall-ml.

marta: leaving a sticky note in docs: how to apply Router rule to divert traffic and the temporary kubectl snippet used. snippet: 
```
# limit concurrency for heavy route
kubectl patch configmap router-config -n infra --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/routes/heavy/concurrency","value":8}]'
```

infra-sre: created INFRA-2387 and linked to this thread. adding logs and LT diffs.

emma: closing loop: queue back to baseline, p99 under SLO. leaving this thread open for postmortem notes.

cs-lead: CS message sent at 04:50 UTC to affected customers.

oncall-ml: postmortem owners: infra-sre (root cause), plat (runbook improvements), api (fallback automation). ETA first draft in 48h.

emma: adding retrospective checklist: test LT creation in a staging account before promoting templates; add an autoscaler dry-run validation.

ops-bot: Incident P1/P2 timeline summary will be posted to #postmortems after draft is ready.

raj: thanks all. if any follow-ups escalate in channel or PD.

marta: tagging follow-up doc: /docs/runbooks/gpu-autoscale-lt-rollback (todo: populate with exact steps).

emma: marking this thread resolved for immediate operational actions; will continue with postmortem write-up.
